newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy stock indices start late due to index update.
newsitem.headline: Italy stock indices start late due to index update.

text.p: The blue-chip Mib30 index and the all-share Mibtel index on the Milan stock exchange will start late on Wednesday, the stock market council said.
A council spokesman said the delay was to allow the Mib30 basket of stocks to be updated.
The basket is being revised, with four companies, including Compart formerly known as Ferruzzi, leaving today and four entering, including media group Mediaset.
The council said it would inform the market later when the indices would be released.
